record_title: Explicit root-linear maps for characteristic-two quaternion division algebras
provenance: A finite 2-basis of the center yields explicit quaternion coordinates for the Frobenius-twisted H/A module, producing a complete basis of root-linear maps and an explicit normal form for range-compatible Hermitian-matrix homomorphisms.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The basis depends on a quaternion presentation and a chosen 2-basis, and the finite-coordinate theorem assumes finite 2-rank. Older characteristic-2 quaternion or p-basis literature may contain an equivalent semilinear decomposition under different terminology. No independent validation is asserted.
